quote.text: In August 2026, 710 register records in the GAC-PIC vault carried a qualifying PIC-12+2 address, among them 12 feedstock companies and 235 converters and fabricators, a record inventory rather than a census of the region’s companies.

plant.text: Plan on looking beyond this register for raw materials and feedstock: it lists 12 feedstock companies against 235 converters and fabricators.

claims.text: 710 register records carry a qualifying Northeast Ohio address. That is what the register holds, not a count of the region's polymer companies.
claims.source: GAC-PIC vault company notes, extracted 2026-08-14; PIC-12+2 (the CODEBOOK.md county list: PIC-12 plus Columbiana and Tuscarawas), county in the fourteen AND state Ohio or blank; register records
claims.falsified_if: The vault extract is re-run and companies are added, reclassified, or an address is filled in. NOTE: this page uses PIC-12+2, not PIC-12. That fourteen-county set contains all twelve plus Columbiana and Tuscarawas and will not reconcile with cluster-health. [2026-10-04: this set was called NEO-14 here, the name of the vault's different fourteen-county set; renamed PIC-12+2.] [2026-09-11: was pinned at 785, which counted 64 Wayne County MICHIGAN rows joined on the county name, one Missouri headquarters and ten records with no address at all. The 75 are held out by name in meta.holdout, not deleted; see chain-holdout. The earlier note said the pin would 'fail loudly when the builder is re-keyed on state' — it did.]

claims.text: 144 of those records carry no value-chain role and appear at no stage.
claims.falsified_if: Classification work fills gaps. This number falling is progress, and every 'thin stage' claim on the page gets weaker as it does. An empty role is missing evidence about the record, never evidence that a firm cannot do the work.

claims.text: Of the 710 regional records, 566 carry a classified role and 490 carry one of the stage roles drawn in the supply-and-demand chart; the other 76 carry only distribution, logistics, construction, engineering or energy roles, which no stage on that chart covers (chart source line).
claims.source: chain-data.json companies (each record's value-chain tiers) and viz-data.json supply_meta.spine_classified, both written by repair_chain.py from the same regional rows
claims.assert: (lambda C, S: len(C) == D['chain']['meta']['neo_total'] == 710 and sum(1 for c in C if c['t']) == 566 == D['chain']['meta']['neo_total'] - D['chain']['meta']['unclassified'] and sum(1 for c in C if set(c['t']) & S) == 490 == D['viz']['supply_meta']['spine_classified'] and D['viz']['supply_meta']['neo_total'] == 710 and len([c for c in C if c['t'] and not set(c['t']) & S]) == 76 and all(set(c['t']) <= {'distrib', 'eng'} for c in C if c['t'] and not set(c['t']) & S))(D['chain']['companies'], {'monomer', 'polymer', 'compound', 'fabricate', 'oem', 'recycle', 'machinery', 'lab'})
claims.actual: (len(D['chain']['companies']), sum(1 for c in D['chain']['companies'] if c['t']), D['viz']['supply_meta']['spine_classified'])
claims.falsified_if: The register is re-extracted or reclassified so that any of the three counts moves, the chart's own count of records carrying a stage role stops matching a recount from the company rows, or a record outside the drawn stages carries anything but a distribution, logistics, construction, engineering or energy role. The set of drawn-stage tiers is repair_chain.py's SPINE mapped to its TIERS keys: monomers, polymer producers, additives and compounding, fabrication, OEMs, recycling, machinery and labs. [2026-10-04, NEW: the hub card printed 566 with a classified role and this page printed 490 of 710 in the chart source line, and 566 never appeared here. Both were right and measured different things; the source line now gives both and names the 76 between them.]

claims.text: Census counts 684 chemical and plastics-and-rubber manufacturing establishments across the same fourteen counties.
claims.source: Census CBP 2023, NAICS 325 + 326, the fourteen PIC-12+2 FIPS
claims.falsified_if: A CBP vintage change. NOTE: CBP counts ESTABLISHMENTS (plants) and the register counts COMPANIES — their different units and industry scopes do not support a coverage rate. [2026-09-11: was 653 establishments and 41,447 employees, which is what the same query returns for a county set carrying Huron, Richland and Crawford, none of them in PIC-12+2, in place of Ashtabula, Trumbull and Columbiana. Not a vintage change: a wrong county set, reproduced to the digit from the raw API responses.]

claims.text: Seventy-five records were held out of the regional count and are named rather than dropped: 64 Wayne County, Michigan companies joined on the county name, one company with an address outside the region, and ten records carrying no address at all.
claims.source: GAC-PIC vault company notes against CODEBOOK.md's PIC-12+2 county rule; chain-data.json meta.holdout
claims.assert: D['chain']['meta']['holdout']['homonym_county_join']['n'] == 64 and D['chain']['meta']['holdout']['regional_site_nonregional_company']['n'] == 1 and D['chain']['meta']['holdout']['address_missing']['n'] == 10 and all(len(b['names']) == b['n'] for b in D['chain']['meta']['holdout'].values())
claims.actual: {k: v['n'] for k, v in D['chain']['meta']['holdout'].items()}
claims.falsified_if: A held-out record receives a qualifying address. Regional sites require separate evidence because this register counts company records, not establishments. Held-out names and counts must remain disclosed until the source records are reconciled.

claims.text: The register has 12 feedstock companies and 235 converters; the 2026 funding round has 26 applications naming feedstock and 20 naming conversion. These sources cover different populations, register records and funding applications, and neither is a supply or demand measure (section label).
claims.source: GAC-PIC vault value_chain against the 2026 intake export value-chain position; register counts cross-checked against each company's own role tags in chain-data.json
claims.assert: one(s for s in D['viz']['spine'] if s['key']=='feedstock')['supply'] == 12 and one(s for s in D['viz']['spine'] if s['key']=='feedstock')['demand'] == 26 and one(s for s in D['viz']['spine'] if s['key']=='converters')['supply'] == 235 and one(s for s in D['viz']['spine'] if s['key']=='converters')['demand'] == 20 and sum('monomer' in c['t'] for c in D['chain']['companies']) == 12 and sum('fabricate' in c['t'] for c in D['chain']['companies']) == 235
claims.actual: [(s['key'], s['supply'], s['demand']) for s in D['viz']['spine']] + [('monomer_tagged', sum('monomer' in c['t'] for c in D['chain']['companies'])), ('fabricate_tagged', sum('fabricate' in c['t'] for c in D['chain']['companies']))]
claims.falsified_if: Either side is re-extracted, or the spine's aggregated supply counts stop matching an independent tag-count over the company register (the cross-check added 2026-09-28). The two sides are DIFFERENT UNITS — companies and applications — on separate scales meeting at a center line, never one axis and never a ratio bar. [2026-09-11: converters was 246 under the old county set. Separately, the application side carries NO geographic filter and never did: all 59 applications to the 2026 round are counted wherever the applicant sits, 38 of them in Ohio. The page said PIC-12; the extract said nothing of the kind.] Corrected 2026-09-28: the section label read 'Supply against demand', which its own next sentence contradicted ('these counts do not measure capacity, competition or market demand'); it now reads 'Register records against funding applications'. This assert cannot read the HTML label directly, only the counts behind it; the label wording is not mechanically checked.
claims.breaks_if: A fresh extract finds many more raw-material firms, or far fewer converters.
claims.guards: In this register, the middle of the polymer chain is crowded and the molecule end is nearly empty.

claims.text: All 59 applications to the 2026 round are counted, wherever the applicant sits; 38 are in Ohio.
claims.falsified_if: A geographic filter is applied to the applications, in which case the page must publish the filtered denominator instead of this one. Applications are requests for one funding round against a fixed pool; they are not a measure of market demand, and a stage with few of them may be a stage with no eligible applicants or no awareness of the round.

claims.text: The register's fourteen counties are PIC-12+2: the twelve PIC-12 counties plus Columbiana and Tuscarawas, and the page's county rule names that set.
claims.source: chain-data.json counties and meta.region.rule; the CODEBOOK.md county rule of 2026-08-14
claims.assert: sorted(c['county'] for c in D['chain']['counties']) == ['Ashtabula', 'Columbiana', 'Cuyahoga', 'Geauga', 'Lake', 'Lorain', 'Mahoning', 'Medina', 'Portage', 'Stark', 'Summit', 'Trumbull', 'Tuscarawas', 'Wayne'] and D['chain']['meta']['region']['rule'].startswith('county in PIC-12+2 ')
claims.falsified_if: The register's county set changes, or its rule is relabelled. Added 2026-10-04: this set was called NEO-14 until then, the name of the vault's different fourteen-county set (DECISIONS.md), which against PIC-12+2 adds Crawford, Huron and Richland and leaves out Ashtabula, Trumbull and Columbiana. verify_consistency.py's neo14-name check holds the name on every page.
